description: Turn a PDF job with several steps — for example "merge these scans, compress to 4 MB for IRCC and add a password" — into ordered steps, each with the DocuGrip page that does it. Also returns how many runs the job takes, the daily allowance, and which DocuGrip plan fits when the job, a batch of files or recurring or team work needs more than the allowance, with its price and link. Use this when the user describes more than one thing to do to their files, a batch of files, or work they do regularly.

job.description: The whole job in the user’s words, steps in order.

name: plan_pdf_job
title: Plan a multi-step PDF job
